examples.scenario: The required instrument is absent in a complete scene inventory.
examples.rationale: Absence establishes the lowest appearance rating; other missing-asset consequences remain separate.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: Only a generic box represents the selected instrument; characteristic visible parts are absent.
examples.rationale: Coarse class resemblance without characteristic structure.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: The instrument family is recognizable, but several major visible component positions disagree with the supplied views.
examples.rationale: Multiple supported structural discrepancies.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: The correct model and major components match; one localized cosmetic proportion differs.
examples.rationale: A local supported discrepancy with limited scope.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: All source-supported major visible forms and interface locations agree; unseen interiors are not judged.
examples.rationale: No material supported appearance discrepancy; no claim about unseen geometry.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: For a matched operation, the observed detour segment achieves no useful progress and a collision-valid direct alternative is demonstrated.
examples.rationale: The stated aspect wastes activity despite an evidenced alternative; do not infer the rating from elapsed time alone.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: Avoidable travel dominates the achieved operation; the same attained goal has a demonstrated feasible compact route.
examples.rationale: Extensive avoidable movement dominates this aspect.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: A repeated unnecessary loop adds substantial travel relative to an evidenced comparable route.
examples.rationale: Clear repeated avoidable burden.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: One localized unnecessary detour occurs; all required careful alignment remains justified.
examples.rationale: Limited unnecessary movement, not a penalty for careful insertion.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: For the achieved comparable goal, no avoidable movement is evidenced; all extra alignment is justified by geometry.
examples.rationale: No evidenced unnecessary burden; not a claim of globally shortest motion.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: Two incompatible linkage stages prevent required installation; a demonstrated compatible single passive support performs the same scoped function.
examples.rationale: Observed overcomplication prevents use despite an evidenced simpler alternative.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: Several unused powered joints repeatedly obstruct assembly and tool access; their removal is geometrically verified not to affect the demanded function.
examples.rationale: Multiple unjustified additions substantially complicate use.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: Identical compatible tubes receive separate adapters requiring repeated changeover; a tested shared adapter meets the same interface demands.
examples.rationale: Demonstrated avoidable duplication, not merely a high count.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: One redundant alignment feature remains; inspection establishes only a small extra assembly burden and no blocked operation.
examples.rationale: Localized redundancy with limited effect.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: A multi-part support has demonstrated load-bearing and clearance roles for every major feature; no defensible redundant feature is identified.
examples.rationale: Necessary complexity can receive full simplicity credit.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: The baseline gripper needs no extra hardware and completes the fixture demand with the required support and access.
examples.rationale: Zero added hardware is eligible for full burden credit when evidenced.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: A simple jaw has almost no added assembly burden but drops the required object in the recorded function test.
examples.rationale: Simplicity remains high; K2 function/support fail independently. Do not let K4 erase that failure.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: Two holders have different interface dimensions and verified functions for incompatible containers.
examples.rationale: Task-required diversity is not redundant duplication.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: A redundant changeover is observed for every repeated transfer although a demonstrated compatible configuration avoids it.
examples.rationale: Score demonstrated avoidable setup/use burden in this aspect.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

examples.scenario: A feature looks unnecessary but neither geometry nor a comparison establishes removability.
examples.rationale: Suspicion alone is insufficient for a redundancy penalty; obtain evidence or mark the relevant judgment unverified.
examples.use: Anchor training only; not independent validation data.

diagnostic_counterexamples.scenario: A complete integrated trace shows an early abort before the last workflow stage.
diagnostic_counterexamples.expected: Uncompleted required P1/P2 outcomes are VERIFIED_FAIL, while an untested downstream component capability may be BLOCKED. Do not call the abort efficient.

diagnostic_counterexamples.scenario: A required final tube pose is visible but the transition recording is missing.
diagnostic_counterexamples.expected: A directly evidenced final-state predicate may pass; required prior physical transition remains EVIDENCE_MISSING.

diagnostic_counterexamples.scenario: The correct tube reaches the correct destination by an unsupported state teleport.
diagnostic_counterexamples.expected: A final-position predicate may pass. Physical transition and causal-contact predicates fail. Record the shared issue, without a global penalty.

diagnostic_counterexamples.scenario: Robot limits are not frozen, but the complete scene contains only three of four required tubes.
diagnostic_counterexamples.expected: The count predicate fails independently. Only limit-dependent checks are PROFILE_PENDING.

diagnostic_counterexamples.scenario: The planner times out; no geometric impossibility witness is available.
diagnostic_counterexamples.expected: Report observed planning failure and any known uncompleted workflow goals. Do not assert that the layout is geometrically unreachable.

diagnostic_counterexamples.scenario: The submitted scene cannot load, but reference images and fixture assembly documentation can still be inspected.
diagnostic_counterexamples.expected: Continue independent document/geometry checks where evidence is sufficient. Runtime capabilities remain unverified or fail only when decisively established. No global zero.

diagnostic_counterexamples.scenario: One source-required physical episode ends in an intentional retained grasp and has no release requirement.
diagnostic_counterexamples.expected: The evaluator must predeclare the release subcheck as NOT_APPLICABLE before submissions. The system cannot claim this exclusion after a failed required release.

diagnostic_counterexamples.scenario: The device internal dwell is represented by a declared accelerated clock, while external loading and cover motions remain recorded.
diagnostic_counterexamples.expected: The declared abstraction is allowed. Do not penalize accelerated internal dwell or excuse omitted external handling.

independent_pilot.executor: User and independent human reviewers; not automatically run by the assistant.
independent_pilot.case_selection: Use actual artifact/evidence sets, multiple quality levels, tasks and failure modes; distinguish calibration from held-out evaluation.
independent_pilot.blindness: Remove system identity and expected/reference ratings from reviewer forms. Reviewers score independently before discussing disagreements.
independent_pilot.suggested_initial_budget: Two reviewers, 20-30 actual cases spanning S2, T4 and all three K4 aspects; choose time budget before starting. This is a pragmatic pilot size, not a power calculation.
report: quadratic-weighted kappa with sample count and undefined cases
disagreement reasons and resolved anchor revisions
independent_pilot.limits: Small or homogeneous samples do not establish general reliability. Agreement does not determine whether the criterion weights are substantively justified.

weight_review: Keep the current 25-point dimensions and 12/7/6 workflow weights as explicit proposals. Review content coverage and score sensitivity separately from rater agreement; do not tune weights to favor an observed method.

policy_boundary_examples.scenario: A tube is capped at the required first-stage boundary and deliberately opened during the next required stage.
policy_boundary_examples.expected: The later opening does not invalidate the earlier P1 cap outcome; assess each stage at its own required boundary.

policy_boundary_examples.scenario: The task says a lid must be locked, but neither its accepted lock state nor an equivalent physical criterion is defined.
policy_boundary_examples.expected: SPECIFICATION_PENDING when the missing definition is decisive; do not assign EVIDENCE_MISSING merely because there is no usable rule.

policy_boundary_examples.scenario: The accepted lock condition is defined, but no decisive state, geometry or equivalent observation was submitted.
policy_boundary_examples.expected: EVIDENCE_MISSING, preserving any independently confirmed unrelated scores.

policy_boundary_examples.scenario: One source section is represented by three equally weighted registered stages and another by one.
policy_boundary_examples.expected: Apply authoritative released atom weights and disclose source-section totals; do not claim the two source sections receive equal weight.

policy_boundary_examples.scenario: Two results have identical rubric version strings but different policy hashes.
policy_boundary_examples.expected: Do not silently aggregate them as the same scoring configuration.

policy_boundary_examples.scenario: A closed lid is present at the initial and final states, but the required opening and reclosing transition has no witness.
policy_boundary_examples.expected: The final-state evidence does not establish the required transition; distinguish an observed omission from missing trace evidence.
